versions.changelog:
Initial release of coding-tutor:

- Introduces a coding tutor supporting Python, JavaScript, and SQL through interactive code examples and explanations.
- Features level-based tutorials, from beginner (HTML/CSS) to advanced (Python + AI).
- Provides debugging tips, code execution instructions, and real-world coding scenarios.
- Emphasizes user engagement with hands-on coding and key concepts.
- Resources include links to FreeCodeCamp and LeetCode for further learning.
